The Lumbridge achievements are a group of Area Tasks subcategories relating to the Lumbridge and Draynor Village area. These subcategories are: Beginner Lumbridge, Easy Lumbridge, Medium Lumbridge, and Hard Lumbridge.

Unlike the other sets of the Area Tasks achievement subcategories, this set has a beginner difficulty instead of the elite difficulty; beginner, easy, medium, and hard. It is the only set of Area Tasks subcategories that free-to-play players can fully complete.

The NPCs for the beginner, easy, medium, and hard subcategories are indicated by a icon on the minimap and the world map. These are Explorer Jack in the house just west of the general store in Lumbridge and Bob the smith in his shop in Lumbridge for the beginner and easy achievements, respectively, and Ned in his house in Draynor Village for the medium and hard achievements.

The rewards for this set of subcategories include the explorer's ring and experience lamps giving a total of 12,000 experience in skills. A player must obtain each explorer's ring in ordinal order (e.g. medium achievements must be completed before the reward for hard achievements is available).

If the ring is lost, it can be retrieved from the NPC who gave the player the ring; Explorer Jack for the explorer's ring 1, Bob the smith for the explorer's ring 2, and Ned for the explorer's ring 3 and 4.

This set of achievement subcategories is required for the Task Master achievement of the completionist cape.

Completing all achievements in this set of subcategories gives a total of 440 RuneScore.

There are 4 achievements in this group.

NameDescriptionMembers
Lumbridge Set Tasks - BeginnerGiven by Explorer Jack in Lumbridge for completing all Beginner Tasks in Lumbridge.5

Lumbridge Set Tasks - HardGiven by Ned in Draynor Village for completing all Hard Tasks in Lumbridge.15

Requirements

RequirementsSkill requirements are not boostable unless marked with a [B] for boostable.

Items requiredItems from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

Rewards

Talk to Explorer Jack, who is located in his house to the west of the general store in Lumbridge, to claim the rewards for the beginner achievement set:

  • An antique lamp granting 500 experience (in the skill of choice of level 1 or higher)
  • Explorer's ring 1, which grants the following bonuses:
Reward When worn When operated At all times
Explorer's ring 1
  • One charge per day to replenish 50% of run energy
Explorer's ring 2
  • 10% chance of crafting an additional air, earth, fire, or water rune per essence, at the appropriate altar (not the Ourania Runecrafting Altar), granting additional experience
  • An additional run replenishment charge per day (2 total)
  • 30 runeless casts of Low Level Alchemy per day; requires level 21 Magic.
Explorer's ring 3
  • An additional run replenishment charge per day (3 total)
  • Cabbageport - Unlimited teleports to the Falador cabbage patch.
Explorer's ring 4
  • 27 runeless casts of Superheat Item per day; requires level 43 Magic
  • 15 runeless casts of High Level Alchemy per day; requires level 55 Magic.
  • 50% chance to not use runes when casting Bones To Bananas, up to 10 times per day
  • Can claim a hamper from the cook once per day

Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

3Have Your Cake and Eat ItCook a chocolate cake from scratch in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. (X/3)
  • 50 Cooking
  •  Cook's Assistant

Bake a chocolate cake from scratch in the Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. For members, all ingredients can be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest, but the cake itself must be made in the kitchen.

To bake a chocolate cake:

  • Mix an egg, a bucket of milk and a pot of flour in a cake tin to create an uncooked cake.
  • Bake the uncooked cake on the cooking range.
  • Add a chocolate bar to the cake to create a chocolate cake (make sure to choose the "Use" option, as the default option is "Eat").
